create.name: Amanda Huggins
create.bio:
Amanda Huggins is an American coach, author and energy worker whose teaching grew out of her own years of struggling with anxiety and self-doubt. She completed 400 hours of yoga teacher training in 2014 and has taught meditation since 2016, the year she opened a holistic coaching practice that joined coaching with body-based, mindset and soul work. She later trained in energy healing and the chakras, naming the author Cyndi Dale as her main teacher and writing chapters for one of Dale's chakra books, and she apprenticed in coaching with Melanie Klein.

She now calls her work integrative healing: one-to-one sessions that begin with energy work, in which she connects with a client's energy and guides, and end with practical coaching on next steps. She also teaches children emotional regulation, grounding and simple meditation, working alongside their parents over Zoom. Her self-paced online courses look at anxious attachment and self-love after a relationship ends, at moving from a scarcity mindset towards abundance, and at a mind, body and soul approach to anxious thoughts. Her book Anxiety to Empowerment, published by Llewellyn in 2024, collects exercises, journal prompts and meditations for understanding anxious patterns.

courses.title: Healing the Heart
courses.description: A self-paced course, once called Relationship Anxiety 101, for people working through an anxious attachment style or the end of a relationship. Six video lessons with journal prompts look at anxious patterns, anger and sadness, self-worth and boundaries, and ways to self-soothe, closing with a self-love meditation.

courses.title: Abundance in Action
courses.description: A self-paced course on noticing scarcity thinking and limiting beliefs and practising a more abundant outlook. It runs in three parts, each pairing a journaling exercise with a meditation, and comes bundled with her introductory anxiety course.

courses.title: Holistic Anxiety Management 101
courses.description: Her introductory self-paced course on working with anxious thoughts through mind, body and soul. Five video lessons with journal prompts move from understanding anxious patterns to processing thoughts and self-empowerment, with a bonus meditation for relaxation.

courses.title: Kids & Family Coaching
courses.description: Weekly online sessions in which she teaches children to name and settle their emotions with grounding, visualisation and mindfulness tools, plus a monthly session with the parents. It runs for at least three months.
